mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly higher than baseline (p>0.05) during easing periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the GDPC1 quarterly index above 11000 triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as it signals robust economic activity.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite crossing above 11000, or IC <0.03 over a 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in both GDPC1 (demand) and HOUST (employment) above specific thresholds signal strong demand growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST above 11000 and 2000 respectively
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positively correlated with both proxies' rise, or IC <0.03 over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a combination of falling UNRATE below 5% and FEDFUNDS below 3.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it indicates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: 20-day returns negative in this regime, or IC <0.03 over an 18-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the PAYEMS monthly index above 133500 indicates strengthening labor markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite crossing above 133500, or IC <0.03 over a 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the INDPRO monthly index above 119.6 signals improved supply conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive despite crossing above 119.6, or IC <0.03 over a 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising FEDFUNDS above 3.05% combined with INDPRO crossing above 120 indicates a shift toward contractionary policy paired with supply growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.5% and INDPRO crosses above 120
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positively correlated with both proxies' rise, or IC <0.03 over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of RSAFS falling below 350000 and FEDFUNDS rising above 3.05% signals a post-shock recovery phase, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns negative in this regime, or IC <0.03 over a 12-month rolling window.
